```{r setup, include = FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(DT)
library(gluedown)
library(magrittr)

hnc <- params$hnc
markers_auto <- params$markers_auto
dt_pg_list <- params$dt_pg_list
dt_log10like <- params$dt_log10like
```

### Genotype combination

```{r echo = FALSE, results='asis'}
n_mk <- length(markers_auto)
for(i in 1:n_mk){
  print(md_bullet(markers_auto[i], marker = "-"))
  
  dt_pg <- dt_pg_list[[i]]
  print(htmltools::tagList(datatable(dt_pg_list[[i]],
                                     selection = "none",
                                     options = list(dom = "t", iDisplayLength = nrow(dt_pg), ordering = FALSE, autowidth = TRUE,
                                     columnDefs = list(list(targets = c(hnc + 1, hnc + 2), visible = FALSE))),
                                     rownames = FALSE
                                     ) %>%
                                     formatSignif(columns = c("Weight"), digits = 3)
                           )
        )
}
```
